description: Reads the site's robots.txt and says whether a crawler may fetch a URL (RFC 9309: the longest matching rule wins, Allow wins a tie), with the matching rule, crawl-delay and sitemaps. No AI involved; if robots.txt cannot be read you are not charged. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL you want to fetch

user_agent.description: Your crawler's name, for example MyBot (default: any crawler)

name: robots_check
title: May a crawler fetch this URL?
